title: Checkpoint starts normally but stalls for 24 minutes because the storage metadata server hangs

expected.reason: Looks like B01 at first, but the checkpoint phase lasts 24 min vs an expected 90 s (16x). Write bandwidth collapses and metadata latency is 4.8 s, so 16 GPUs idle on storage.
keySignals: write throughput collapsed after initial burst

context.note: Pair with B01. The deterministic rule must use the duration bound, not just 'phase = checkpoint => ignore'.
